latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Beginners Photo Video: easily turn 5–10 photos into 1080p shareable videos in under a minute using simple prompts.
- No need for manual editing—just upload photos and describe your desired result.
- Seamless cloud processing with automatic session/token management; setup completes with a “Ready!” notification.
- Exports support MP4 (default) plus other video, image, and audio formats. Max file size: 200MB.
- Common workflows include quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement with easy re-edits.
